name: [❄️] School FR RP 🇫🇷
desc:
🏫 Become the most popular student in school! 
👔 Create your own courses as a teacher! 
🍳 Prepare dishes as a cook! 
🅿 Become a supervisor to enforce the rules! 
💼 Manage the time schedules and the building as a provisor! 
🎒 Earn money for exclusive items! 
📏 Will you be a hard-working student or a rebellious one? 
❔ Discover the mysteries of the establishment ! 
🔥 And much more! 

Welcome to the French School RP of Roblox!

This School RP experience is a school with a unique middle school/high school experience. You can play in a school as a teacher, student, cook... A typical game with voice chat!

Moderators are present to ensure that you have high-quality role-play in this game, and we do our best to ensure that this school role-play meets your expectations! (Codes / Events / RP Servers)

Will you become the most diligent or most rebellious student of this School RP?
